name: Send daily funding round alerts from Bounce Watch to Slack

parameters.content:
## Send daily funding round alerts from Bounce Watch to Slack

Bounce Watch tells you what just happened at a company and when — funding, senior hires, new offices, customer wins and partnerships, each carrying its own date. What the API covers: bouncewatch.com/products/data-enrichment-api

A round closing is the clearest buying signal there is: budget has arrived, and it arrived for a reason somebody has already written down. This workflow posts the rounds in your market to Slack every morning.

### How it works

A daily schedule starts the run. A Settings node holds the country code and the lookback window, so changing the market is a one-field edit rather than a hunt through node parameters. The Bounce Watch node searches for funding signals in that window and returns one item per company, with the round and its date attached. The Slack node posts each company as its own message, carrying the company, what it raised, the date and a link to the profile.

### Setup

1. Get an API key at bouncewatch.com/register/api. It is free, no card, and every new account starts with 2,500 credits. Paste it into the Bounce Watch credential.
2. Set the country code and the window in Search settings.
3. Pick your Slack credential and choose the channel on the last node.

An empty run means nothing matched the filters, not that those companies were quiet.

### Customization tips

Add a headcount band or a funding stage to the search filters to keep the channel to companies you would actually sell to. Widen the signal keys to include fundraising intent if you want to hear about rounds before they close.

## The market you sell into

Daily run, one country, one window.
Change the market in one field.

## The rounds

One message per company.
Dates are printed as stamps, not claims.
